Class ContentMap

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.xds.core.metadata.ContentMap
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Document
public class ContentMap extends Object implements Serializable
Thread-safe content map that stores and manages typed document content. Supports automatic type conversion using a configurable TypeConverter.

This class allows storing multiple representations of the same content in different types and automatically converts between them when needed.

Thread Safety: This class is thread-safe and can be used in concurrent environments.

Author:
Dmytro Rud

  • Method Details

    • getContent

      public <T> T getContent(Class<T> targetType)
      Retrieves document content of the specified type.

      If content of the requested type is not directly available, this method attempts to convert existing content from another type using the configured TypeConverter. Successfully converted content is cached for future use.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the inferred desired content type
      Parameters:
      targetType - the desired content type (must not be null)
      Returns:
      content of the given type, or null when content of the desired type is neither already present nor can be automatically generated from an existing one
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if targetType is null

      Type Parameters:
      T - the inferred content type
      Parameters:
      contentType - the content type (must not be null)
      content - the content to store (must not be null)
      Returns:
      the previous content associated with the type, or null if none existed
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if contentType or content is null
